objective: Theory spec of force-field solar modulation in theory:heliospheric-modulation, with its validity range, its limits and the power-law closed-form benchmark

model.description: Force-field approximation of solar modulation: zero radial streaming, spherical symmetry, steady state, diffusion coefficient kappa_1(r) beta R; J_TOA(T) = p(T)^2 / p(T + |Z| phi)^2 J_LIS(T + |Z| phi). Numbers come from the hep-measurement force-field script; the closed forms for a power-law LIS are the benchmark

assumptions: zero radial streaming (force-field equation); spherical symmetry; steady state within a period
diffusion coefficient separable and proportional to rigidity: kappa = kappa_1(r) beta R
phi(r) = int_r^r_b V / (3 kappa_1) dr', zero at the modulation boundary r_b
one modulation potential phi per period; no charge-sign, drift, latitude or transient effects
LIS given as input (power law in the benchmark, synthetic normalization and index)

conventions.unit_system: natural-HEP with c = 1 and e = 1: energies and momenta in GeV, rigidity in GV, modulation potential phi in GV (|Z| phi in GeV); fluxes per unit of the energy variable of the chosen kind, arbitrary normalization in the benchmark
conventions.scales: not-applicable (no renormalization or factorization scale); one modulation potential phi per period
conventions.energy_variable: one of: total kinetic energy T of the nucleus (GeV, shift |Z| phi); kinetic energy per nucleon T/A (GeV/n, shift (|Z|/A) phi) [helmod:C04]; rigidity R = p/|Z| (GV); the LIS power law and the flux are per unit of the same variable
conventions.frame: heliocentric; LIS at the modulation boundary, TOA at 1 AU
conventions.mass_approximation: rest mass of the whole nucleus given by the caller (no particle constants shipped); per-nucleon mass m/A
conventions.helmod:modulation_model: force field (Gleeson-Axford): zero streaming, spherical symmetry, steady state, diffusion coefficient proportional to rigidity; J_TOA(T) = p(T)^2 / p(T + |Z| phi)^2 J_LIS(T + |Z| phi) [helmod:C01]
conventions.helmod:observable: differential flux at 1 AU (top of the atmosphere) predicted from a LIS; no charge-sign, drift, latitude or transient effects

extension.order: not-applicable (closed-form solution of the force-field equation, no perturbative expansion)

validity_domain.kinetic_energy_per_nucleon_gev: above about 0.30 (protons) and 0.25 (alpha particles) [helmod:C03]; other species not stated
validity_domain.physics: steady modulation within a period; charge-sign, drift and transient effects absent [helmod:C05]

checks_run.name: f = F(T + Z phi) solves the force-field equation; F(T - Z phi) does not (SymPy)
T + Z phi constant along the characteristic (SymPy)
p^2 = T (T + 2m) = E^2 - m^2, the Gleeson-Axford invariant (SymPy)
per-nucleon and rigidity closed forms equal the total-energy relation times the Jacobians (SymPy)
limits: phi -> 0 returns the LIS; ratio 1 - (gamma + 2) Z phi / T at large T; flux linear in T as T -> 0 (SymPy)
hep-measurement force-field script vs closed form, 90 synthetic points (2 species, 3 phi, 3 energy kinds)
script demodulate inverts its own modulate (round trip)
units: phi in GV, |Z| phi in GeV with e = 1; flux ratio dimensionless

checks_not_run: comparison with a numerical transport solution (with streaming) or a drift model
comparison with a published modulated spectrum or phi series
neglected: radial streaming (adiabatic and convective terms beyond the force-field limit)
gradient, curvature and current-sheet drifts (charge-sign dependence)
Forbush decreases and solar energetic particle events
degenerate_directions: phi vs LIS spectral shape (injection and transport parameters)
